templates.source: Fanvil Knowledge Base article 'How to integrate with Fanvil IP phones' (kb.fanvil.com, Door Phone & Indoor Station > How To Guide & Video > Integration; dated 2025-11-12), section 4 'Video Monitor': 'Note: Monitoring address: rtsp://admin:admin@172.18.28.30/h264/stream.live0'. This is the RTSP URL of the Fanvil door phone camera feed (example uses the i68 door phone monitored from a V67 SIP phone). Default RTSP port 554 (implicit — no port in the documented URL).

unverified_leads.note: Truncated form of the documented path — the full official path is /h264/stream.live0 (see main template). On its own, without the /h264 prefix, this is not the documented URL.

Plausible second-stream variant (/h264/stream.live1) by analogy to stream.live0, but Fanvil's KB documents only stream.live0 for the door phone camera. No official Fanvil source confirms a stream.live1 path.
Generic Dahua/OEM-style query-string RTSP path; not used by Fanvil. Cross-brand contamination in the scan DB.

notes: Fanvil (fanvil.com, Chinese SIP-endpoint maker) is primarily a VoIP/intercom vendor; the cameras in scope are the video door phones / video intercoms (i-series e.g. i68, i33V, i16V). Fanvil's official Knowledge Base documents the door phone camera RTSP feed as rtsp://<user>:<pass>@<ip>/h264/stream.live0 (H.264). Default RTSP port 554. Only a single stream path (stream.live0) is documented; sub-stream paths are not published.
